cases.name: Hill Post
cases.title: Hill Post — Put optional ride arithmetic together after the current road
cases.message: the current map and road choices lead three optional ways to inspect the ride
cases.steps: Replace the current positions of #ride-legs, #ride-budget-reader and #retrace-route with one closed details#ride-readers immediately after p#route. Move these three intact existing details inside it in their original order. Keep each inner summary and helper. Keep #road-choices independent and before #route; actions/Undo after the new outer drawer. Do not move the delivery selector/search, route text, map, distance/climb/allowance/status or comparison/pair doors. Opening readers does not ride a road or alter a delivery.
cases.palette: paper #f1efdc, green ink #203a32, orange #d46a3c; existing Georgia/system16
copy: Heights use one scale for this delivery. Horizontal positions follow distance already ridden.
Orange is the current ride; the dashed line is the kept ride on this delivery. Each route fills the width of its own distance, so compare total distance in the ride table.
Orange is distance spent; green is climbing spent. Each line is scaled to its own allowance, or to the amount already spent when you went over. Downhill never lowers the climbing total.
These are new costs on the roads already ridden, not a refund. Undo changes the attempt instead of riding back.

cases.name: Hill Post
cases.title: Hill Post — Keep and return an attempt in the same comparison drawer
cases.message: keeping and returning a ride share their own place while Undo remains beside the current ride
cases.steps: Move only existing button#remember-ride from the direct .actions row into the existing .actions inside #ride-comparison, immediately before #return-kept-ride. Keep the comparison details closed by default, its summary and table/readout unchanged. Leave direct Undo road, Undo to last junction and Restart delivery in the live actions row, in that order. No state, comparison, filtering or geometry handler changes. Re-scope inherited styles if necessary; do not clone buttons or remove their disabled state.
cases.palette: paper #f1efdc, green ink #203a32, orange #d46a3c; existing Georgia/system16
copy: Ride at least one road, then keep it to compare another attempt.

cases.name: Hill Post
cases.title: Hill Post — Keep finding another delivery optional while the current ride stays first
cases.message: the title finder opens silently while the delivery choice and map remain direct
copy: Filter titles without changing the ride. The current delivery stays in the menu, even when its title does not match.
cases.steps: Inside .selector wrap the intact .title-filter div in closed details#delivery-finder, before the existing label/select#delivery. Keep all search input attributes, counter/help and734's fixed selector width/reserved counter height unchanged inside. Leave the Delivery label and select, current title/brief and map outside. Width100% for the finder, no filter-on-toggle handler or automatic focus. Opening it does not filter, restart or alter a ride; typing still uses734's title-only matching. Also run tools/planner-title-filter.cjs after the new layout check, against preview and public. The planner has already updated that old test's initial copy-reading step to reveal the search's actual ancestor before using innerText; all filter/Undo/group assertions remain unchanged.
